description: Port the custom tool rendering system. Extensions can define renderCall (custom tool call display) and renderResult (custom tool result display) on registered tools. ToolRenderContext (types.ts 391-416) provides args, toolCallId, invalidate, lastComponent, state, cwd, executionStarted, argsComplete, isPartial, expanded, showImages, isError. Also: renderShell (control rendering mode), prepareArguments (compatibility shim), executionMode (per-tool sequential/parallel override), promptSnippet and promptGuidelines (tool-specific system prompt additions). Upstream: types.ts 391-468.
title: Tool rendering: renderCall, renderResult, ToolRenderContext
